actions.reason: C0001 has coherent adjusted-significant RNA and CNV identity evidence (coagulation/EMT/E2F up, fatty-acid metabolism down, 9p21/CDKN2A loss) with no technical confounder support. Cross-modal structure is weak but present, and no available request could resolve it further; retained as a discovery-stage candidate with residual structural uncertainty.

C0002 shows coherent RNA signaling and CNV identity evidence (TGF-beta/WNT/Notch up, ROS down, chr14q loss) with moderate cross-modal stability and no technical confounder support. Boundaries remain somewhat uncertain, but no available request could resolve this; retained for downstream validation.

C0003 has strong coherent immune-inflamed RNA and striking BAP1-enriched/PBRM1-depleted mutation evidence, with no technical confounder support. Cross-modal coherence is driven largely by WXS with limited stability, but no available request could resolve this; retained as a discovery-stage candidate.

C0004 lacks adjusted-significant biological evidence in any modality, but shows highly stable internal structure driven by WXS and no technical confounder support. Identity remains weak and uncertain; no available request could resolve this, so it is retained only as a provisional discovery-stage candidate.

C0005 has strong coherent mutation evidence (complete VHL and PBRM1 absence, adjusted-significant) with directionally consistent RNA downregulation and no technical confounder support. Cross-modal coherence is essentially WXS-driven with low membership support, but no available request could resolve this; retained for downstream validation.

C0006 shows coherent metabolic RNA identity evidence with adjusted-significant 3p/VHL-region CNV loss and DST mutation enrichment, and no technical confounder support. Cross-modal structure is weak, but no available request could resolve this; retained as a discovery-stage candidate.
